DIAGNOPSIS: Progressive Supranuclear Palsy (PSP) - Richardson syndrome variant

Alternative considerations:
1. Dorsal midbrain lesion (Parinaud syndrome or other structural cause)
2. Niemann-Pick disease type C (adult onset)
3. Normal pressure hydrocephalus with midbrain compression
order_raw:
1. Assess thyroid gland by palpation
2. Blood tests for thyroid function (TSH, free T4, free T3)
3. Blood tests for thyroid antibodies (anti-TPO, TSH receptor antibodies)
4. Measure degree of eye protrusion with exophthalmometer
5. Assess extraocular movements in all directions
6. Check for lid retraction and lid lag
7. Orbital imaging (CT or MRI orbits)
